results.text: Wanting somebody doesn't tell me whether I should have children with her or build a life with her. One of the stupid things my brain can do is turn “I'm taking a chance on her” into “she's the right person” after we've been together for a while. Based on what? Sometimes I actually learned something. Sometimes nothing changed except that now I'm attached, and the new certainty is just harder for me to question.
